<|im_start|>system
# Tools

You have access to the following functions:

<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "description": "Return a deterministic weather snapshot.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string", "description": "City to check."}, "day": {"type": "string", "description": "Day label such as today or tomorrow."}}, "required": ["city", "day"]}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "estimate_travel", "description": "Estimate deterministic travel time for a route.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"origin": {"type": "string", "description": "Starting location."}, "destination": {"type": "string", "description": "Destination location."}, "depart_window": {"type": "string", "description": "Departure window label."}}, "required": ["origin", "destination", "depart_window"]}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "reserve_room", "description": "Reserve a meeting room with an explicit time range.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"room": {"type": "string", "description": "Room name."}, "start_time": {"type": "string", "description": "Local start time."}, "end_time": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Local end time."}}, "required": ["room", "start_time"]}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_incident", "description": "Look up an incident status.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"incident_id": {"type": "string", "description": "Incident id in INC-#### format."}}, "required": ["incident_id"]}}}
</tools>

If you choose to call a function ONLY reply in the following format with NO suffix:

<tool_call>
<function=example_function_name>
<parameter=example_parameter_1>
value_1
</parameter>
<parameter=example_parameter_2>
This is the value for the second parameter
that can span
multiple lines
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<IMPORTANT>
Reminder:
- Function calls MUST follow the specified format: an inner <function=...></function> block must be nested within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags
- Required parameters MUST be specified
- You may provide optional reasoning for your function call in natural language BEFORE the function call, but NOT after
- If there is no function call available, answer the question like normal with your current knowledge and do not tell the user about function calls
</IMPORTANT>

You are a concise trip-planning assistant. Use tools for live facts.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
Pick a better city for an outdoor team lunch today: Seattle or Portland. Check both first.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>

</think>

I will check Seattle first, then compare it with Portland.

<tool_call>
<function=get_weather>
<parameter=city>
Seattle
</parameter>
<parameter=day>
today
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<tool_response>
{"city":"Seattle","day":"today","condition":"rain","high_c":12,"wind_kph":22}
</tool_response><|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>

</think>

Seattle looks wet, so I will check Portland before deciding.

<tool_call>
<function=get_weather>
<parameter=city>
Portland
</parameter>
<parameter=day>
today
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<tool_response>
{"city":"Portland","day":"today","condition":"cloudy","high_c":16,"wind_kph":11}
</tool_response><|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>

</think>

Choose Portland. It is cloudy rather than rainy, warmer, and less windy; keep Seattle as the indoor fallback.<|im_end|>
